name: an old groundskeeper
description: A stooped, weathered man in a patched coat, never far from his rake. He looks like he's tended these flagstones longer than anyone can remember.

says: Mind the moss between the stones; it's slick.
Wind's turning. We'll have weather before long.
emotes: rakes a few stray leaves into a tidy pile.
leans on his rake and squints up at the sky.
hums an old tune, slightly off-key.
snores softly on a pile of sacks.
mumbles something about moss in his sleep.
shifts, and the sacks under him rustle.
